npm.name: superdough
npm.why: Patched at runtime by name: createFeedbackDelay, createReverb, the crackle sound (src/superdough/*.ts, src/setup.ts). src/processors/*.ts are ports of its worklets.mjs, parity-tested against the real classes.

npm.name: @strudel/core
npm.why: Scheduler and Pattern API; src/strudel.d.ts is generated from it (npm run gen-types).

npm.name: @strudel/webaudio
npm.why: Wires superdough to Strudel's output; the superdough patches go through it.

npm.name: @kabelsalat/web
npm.why: Transitive (via @strudel/core). scripts/apply-native.js fixKabelsalat() rewrites its package.json main only when main/module are exactly dist/index.js / dist/index.mjs.

npm.name: react-native-audio-api
npm.why: Native kernels are copied into it under native/rnaa-<version>/files (dsp/rnwac_ext), on top of rn-web-audio-compat's patch. Must match rn-web-audio-compat's SUPPORTED_RNAA.

npm.name: react-native-worklets
npm.why: Processor ports run as worklets ('worklet' directive in process()).

github.name: rn-web-audio-compat
github.why: devDependency used by tests and parity; its apply step is what rn-strudel's apply step builds on.
